Enumeration is i < j by construction; report the pair count and confirm the diagonal is absent by construction rather than filtered.

constraints: C2 STOP-CONDITION CLOCK, IDENTICAL ACROSS EVERY CARD. First act: commit a stamp with start_utc, start_epoch, declared_wall_clock_seconds and a COMPUTED binding_stop_utc. Stamp each section boundary with utc, elapsed_s and a marker. HALT at binding_stop_utc, record halted_on_budget truthfully and NAME the dropped work. Halting on the stamp is FULL COMPLIANCE.

INFERENCE BLOCK on every declared artifact: policy, requested_policy, the ACTUAL resolved model identifier, fallback_used, model_verified (false if the adapter probe was not run), standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c. An unobserved resolved model is `unrecorded`, never guessed.

EDIT NO IMMUTABLE ARTIFACT. EXP-DEP-001, EXP-EQD-001, EXP-DS-001 and EXP-SMTH-001/002 are frozen. A needed change is a SUPERSEDING contract under a new id, never an edit. DEC-20260801-011 rank 1 explicitly forbids reusing EXP-SMTH-001's UNAPPROVED contract.

TOY TIER ONLY. No crypto-scale, medium-scale, affected-scheme or asymptotic claim. Every conclusion is scoped to the curves, parameters, solver and budget actually used. A recollection of the literature may be used neither to promote NOR to dismiss (DEC-20260731-019 ruling 3).
RE-HASH THE CONTRACT BEFORE THE FIRST DATUM AND HALT IF IT DIFFERS FROM freeze_receipt.json. Record the hash you computed in run_manifest.json either way.
MEASURE THE NULL FIRST AND COMMIT IT BEFORE THE TREATMENT ARM. A null calibrated after seeing the treatment is not a null.
This task FACTORS INTEGERS. Record the factoring backend, its version, and its exact invocation; a factorization that failed or timed out is recorded as such and its sample EXCLUDED, never imputed.
A timeout, crash or infra failure is NOT negative evidence about HEUR-DS-1. Record it as resource exhaustion.
Apply the pre-registered rules AS WRITTEN. If a rule turns out to be ill-defined on the data, say so and report the raw quantity; do NOT silently substitute a different rule.
deliverables: null_calibration.json: the MEASURED null distribution at the actual X, with sample size, seeds, and the empirical KS/rate-band/tail quantiles the contract's rules refer to.
RESULTS.json: the measured smoothness quantity beside each pre-registered rule and its verdict, with the raw counts, not only the derived statistics.
run_manifest.json: exact commands, exit statuses, seeds, tool and library versions, git commit and dirty-tree state, the contract hash, and every check that did not run with its reason.
handoff.objective: Run the frozen contract: FIRST measure the null distribution at the actual X, THEN measure the smoothness quantity, and report both against the pre-registered rules.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether HEUR-DS-1's smoothness assumption holds at the tested scale, measured directly rather than assumed -- the measurement BATCH-024 closed without performing.
